# Birch: Breathe, Relax & Sleep (full details)

Birch is a free app for iPhone and Apple Watch. Breathing is the core: pick a pattern and follow a visual guide (and, on Apple Watch, haptic cues) for each inhale, hold, and exhale. Small daily habits live beside your breathing in the same app.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/birch-breathe-relax-sleep/id6449722381
Price: Free. No ads, no subscription, no in-app purchases, no account.
Rating: 4.9 average from 115 US App Store ratings.
Requires: iOS on iPhone; watchOS 11 or later for the Apple Watch app.
Developer: Tsukemen.io

## Breathing

- Weil Method: inhale 4, hold 7, exhale 8 (often called 4-7-8 breathing)
- Box Breathing: 4-4-4-4
- Gentle Wave: inhale 7, exhale 11
- Balance
- Heart Coherence
- Slow-Paced breathing
- Choose a duration or a number of cycles. The screen paces each phase so you don't have to count.
- Sessions can be saved as Mindful Minutes in Apple Health.

## Habits

- Built-in ideas: drink water, take vitamins, read, fast, walk, meditate. You can also create your own with any emoji and color.
- Each habit is yes/no or a count (for example 3 of 8 glasses of water).
- Log in one tap, for today or a recent day.
- Reminders at times you choose, plus optional weekly and monthly recaps.
- A week view and calendar show breathing cycles and completed habits together, with streaks and monthly summaries.

## Apple Watch (new in Birch 3.5)

- Six breathing patterns on your wrist.
- Sessions from 1 to 5 minutes.
- Haptic cues for inhale, hold, and exhale.
- Completed sessions sync to Birch on iPhone and can save Mindful Minutes to Apple Health.

## Privacy

- No account and nothing to sign up for.
- Privacy policy: https://birch-breathe.vercel.app/privacy

## FAQ

Q: Is Birch free?
A: Yes. Free on the App Store, with no ads, no subscription, and no in-app purchases.

Q: Do I need an account?
A: No.

Q: Does Birch work with Apple Health?
A: Sessions can count toward Mindful Minutes in Apple Health.

Q: Is Birch on Apple Watch?
A: Yes, on watchOS 11 or later.

## Disclaimer

Birch supports general wellness. It is not a medical device and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.
